ext":"反派魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":75,"text":"反派魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":81,"text":"魔法少女（反派）","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_divine_stone","mentions":[{"paragraph":84,"text":"神典石","occurrence":0,"name":true}]}],"disclosures":[{"id":"d_01","from":2,"to":2,"text":"本书出场角色均已满18岁，不存在任何未成年人。","channel":"author","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d_02","from":6,"to":6,"text":"吐掉牙膏泡沫后，苏天晴放下猫猫水杯与牙刷，双手撑住洗手池，抬头看向镜子里的金毛狐狐。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su_current","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_03","from":7,"to":7,"text":"镜中的金毛狐狐五官无可挑剔，精致可爱，毛发柔顺肌肤光滑，能从宽松睡衣领口瞥见浅浅河谷，眼眸不安中带惊讶，仿佛有狐人生来便有的魅意。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_04","from":8,"to":8,"text":"苏天晴认为抛开离谱的反派魔法少女不谈，这副身体的模样绝妙中的绝妙。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_villain_role","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_05","from":12,"to":12,"text":"苏天晴觉得美妙，自己真是太可爱了。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_06","from":13,"to":14,"text":"苏天晴认为面庞和身材都与自己曾经想象中的完美匹配，萝莉本身就是最美妙的奖励。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_07","from":17,"to":17,"text":"苏天晴意识到自己舔镜的举动很像变态，微红脸收敛，开始认真审视身体中残留的记忆。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su_current","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_08","from":18,"to":18,"text":"这副身体的原主人叫苏天晴；这里与苏天晴曾经的世界相差无几，但人类与兽人共存。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su_original","r_beastkin"]},{"id":"d_09","from":19,"to":19,"text":"这里的兽人指猫娘狐娘，不是从地里长出来的大菌子绿皮。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_beastkin"]},{"id":"d_10","from":20,"to":20,"text":"兽人数量远不及人类；原主人苏天晴从小孤独长大，社恐孤僻，受兽人互助协会资助考上蓉城最好的医学院，临近开学染上兽人流感，熬夜中突发暴发性心肌炎。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su_original","r_beastkin","r_rongcheng"]},{"id":"d_11","from":21,"to":21,"text":"苏天晴心想原主人的死法和自己一模一样。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_su_original"]},{"id":"d_12","from":26,"to":26,"text":"苏天晴问古书：小破书你在吗？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_ancient_book"]},{"id":"d_13","from":27,"to":28,"text":"古书沉默，没有像刚才那样开口说话。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_ancient_book"]},{"id":"d_14","from":29,"to":29,"text":"苏天晴猜测所谓的反派魔法少女可能根本不存在。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_villain_role"]},{"id":"d_15","from":30,"to":33,"text":"苏天晴翻开古书扉页，一枚金色十字星从书里掉出，砸在毫无防备的苏天晴脸上。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su_current","r_ancient_book","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_16","from":35,"to":35,"text":"苏天晴喊疼，发现鼻血冒出来。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":[]},{"id":"d_17","from":36,"to":36,"text":"金毛狐狐怪叫着抓纸巾，没注意到金色十字星上的鼻血在微光后融入十字星中消失。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox_body","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_18","from":37,"to":39,"text":"陌生声音在狐狐脑中响起，宣布守护之星激活，秘典序章已完成，开启每日任务。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_system_voice","about":["r_guardian_star","r_daily_task","r_ancient_book"]},{"id":"d_19","from":40,"to":40,"text":"苏天晴惊讶每日任务与守护之星竟然是真的。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_daily_task","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_20","from":41,"to":41,"text":"狐狐愣了一下，回头看向发微光的金色十字星，把它重新拿在手里。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox_body","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_21","from":42,"to":42,"text":"苏天晴判断金色十字星材质不明、做工精致、手感扎实、不像塑料玩具，应该是魔法少女必备的变身道具。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_22","from":43,"to":45,"text":"苏天晴思考每日任务要怎么查看，是否像前世网络小说一样默念系统，或者有特别解锁密码。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_daily_task"]},{"id":"d_23","from":46,"to":46,"text":"相较于莫名其妙的秘典，苏天晴对守护之星更感兴趣，眼中放出光彩。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_guardian_star","r_ancient_book"]},{"id":"d_24","from":47,"to":47,"text":"苏天晴想到魔法少女变身、穿华丽洋装在城市间穿梭飞行与怪人战斗，这具身体的原主人也曾经梦想过这种场面。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_su_original","r_villain_role"]},{"id":"d_25","from":48,"to":48,"text":"苏天晴自问要不要试试看。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_26","from":50,"to":50,"text":"狐狐试探性喊出变身。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_27","from":52,"to":52,"text":"苏天晴疑问变身不是这么喊，或要加前缀。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su_current","about":[]},{"id":"d_28","from":53,"to":56,"text":"狐狐先后喊出魔法少女变身、henshin、光啊、盖亚。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":[]},{"id":"d_29","from":57,"to":57,"text":"狐狐嗓子快喊哑，把能想到的变身词全喊了一遍，十字星仍无动静。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox_body","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_30","from":58,"to":58,"text":"苏天晴抱怨秘典不给新手指引，别人拿到系统有新手任务，至少该教怎么变身。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_ancient_book","r_daily_task"]},{"id":"d_31","from":59,"to":59,"text":"苏天晴觉得破玩意没意思。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_32","from":60,"to":63,"text":"狐狐气鼓鼓地瘫在沙发上，随手将十字星拿到面前端详，没见上面有写字，心中设想敲一下或搓动某个位置等办法；随后苏天晴盯着十字星中央能容纳一只手指的凹陷看了半晌，试探着将拇指摁了进去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox_body","r_su_current","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_33","from":64,"to":65,"text":"光芒笼罩客厅，一瞬白光消失，身体各处传来轻盈触感，脑海响起莫名声音。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su_current","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_34","from":66,"to":66,"text":"系统宣告初次变身已完成。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_system_voice","about":["r_su_current"]},{"id":"d_35","from":67,"to":67,"text":"苏天晴茫然惊叫什么东西。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su_current","about":[]},{"id":"d_36","from":68,"to":68,"text":"苏天晴意识到原来是触摸屏，还以为是声控。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_37","from":69,"to":73,"text":"苏天晴感受变身力量，走到卧室落地镜前，看到过膝白袜、金色短款洋装、缎带、胸前金色十字星、大尾巴与兽耳的华丽模样。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su_current","r_fox_body","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_38","from":74,"to":75,"text":"看到变身后的模样，苏天晴对反派魔法少女身份的残存不满和抵触荡然无存，决心当这个反派魔法少女。","channel":"thought","mode":"promise","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_villain_role"]},{"id":"d_39","from":76,"to":76,"text":"镜中的狐狐眼神坚定，在胸前握紧拳头。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_40","from":77,"to":77,"text":"苏天晴想接下来该看看每日任务是怎么回事。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_daily_task"]},{"id":"d_41","from":78,"to":79,"text":"苏天晴维持变身后状态走回客厅，拿起不会说话的黑色古书小心翻开，第一页浮现几行文字。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su_current","r_ancient_book"]},{"id":"d_42","from":80,"to":81,"text":"书页显示身份：苏天晴，魔法少女（反派）。","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_ancient_book","about":["r_su_current","r_villain_role"]},{"id":"d_43","from":82,"to":84,"text":"书页发布每日任务1：找茬魔法少女；正牌魔法少女在蓉城风生水起已经够久了，给她一点颜色瞧瞧；奖励100神典石。","channel":"document","mode":"request","holder":"r_ancient_book","about":["r_daily_task","r_official_magical_girl","r_rongcheng","r_divine_stone"]},{"id":"d_44","from":85,"to":85,"text":"苏天晴疑问：找茬正牌魔法少女？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_official_magical_girl","r_daily_task"]},{"id":"d_45","from":86,"to":87,"text":"苏天晴微微一怔，觉得这看似简单的日常任务好像还真不好做。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_daily_task"]}],"beats":[{"id":"b_01","from":1,"to":3,"gist":"章节标题、作者关于角色均满18岁的声明与分隔线。","mode":"paratext","about":[]},{"id":"b_02","from":4,"to":16,"gist":"苏天晴洗漱后照镜自赏狐狐身体，舔镜并沉溺于可爱。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su_current","r_fox_body"]},{"id":"b_03","from":17,"to":23,"gist":"苏天晴审视身体残留记忆，得知原主人同名、世界人类与兽人共存、原主人孤独经历与相同死法，并感到幻痛。","mode":"exposition","about":["r_su_current","r_su_original","r_beastkin","r_rongcheng"]},{"id":"b_04","from":24,"to":30,"gist":"苏天晴到客厅拿古书询问，古书沉默，她怀疑反派魔法少女不存在，翻书扉页。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su_current","r_ancient_book","r_villain_role"]},{"id":"b_05","from":31,"to":36,"gist":"金色十字星从书中掉出砸到苏天晴脸，鼻血流出并融入十字星。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su_current","r_fox_body","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"b_06","from":37,"to":41,"gist":"陌生声音宣布守护之星激活、秘典序章完成与开启每日任务，狐狐惊愣后重新拿起十字星。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_system_voice","r_guardian_star","r_daily_task","r_ancient_book"]},{"id":"b_07","from":42,"to":48,"gist":"苏天晴端详十字星，猜测它是变身道具，思考如何查看每日任务，并对守护之星与原主人梦想产生兴趣。","mode":"reflection","about":["r_su_current","r_guardian_star","r_daily_task","r_su_original","r_villain_role","r_ancient_book"]},{"id":"b_08","from":49,"to":63,"gist":"狐狐尝试各种变身词均失败，抱怨秘典无指引，最后按压十字星凹陷。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_fox_body","r_su_current","r_guardian_star","r_ancient_book","r_daily_task"]},{"id":"b_09","from":64,"to":76,"gist":"白光后初次变身完成，苏天晴看到华丽狐狐魔法少女装束，接受反派身份并握拳。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su_current","r_guardian_star","r_villain_role","r_fox_body","r_system_voice"]},{"id":"b_10","from":77,"to":87,"gist":"苏天晴查看黑色古书中的每日任务，看到身份、找茬正牌魔法少女任务与100神典石奖励，觉得任务不好做。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su_current","r_ancient_book","r_daily_task","r_official_magical_girl","r_rongcheng","r_divine_stone","r_villain_role"]}]}

原主人的死法和自己一模一样。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_su_original"]},{"id":"d_12","from":26,"to":26,"text":"苏天晴问古书：小破书你在吗？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_ancient_book"]},{"id":"d_13","from":27,"to":28,"text":"古书沉默，没有像刚才那样开口说话。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_ancient_book"]},{"id":"d_14","from":29,"to":29,"text":"苏天晴猜测所谓的反派魔法少女可能根本不存在。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_villain_role"]},{"id":"d_15","from":30,"to":33,"text":"苏天晴翻开古书扉页，一枚金色十字星从书里掉出，砸在毫无防备的苏天晴脸上。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su_current","r_ancient_book","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_16","from":35,"to":35,"text":"苏天晴喊疼，发现鼻血冒出来。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":[]},{"id":"d_17","from":36,"to":36,"text":"金毛狐狐怪叫着抓纸巾，没注意到金色十字星上的鼻血在微光后融入十字星中消失。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox_body","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_18","from":37,"to":39,"text":"陌生声音在狐狐脑中响起，宣布守护之星激活，秘典序章已完成，开启每日任务。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_system_voice","about":["r_guardian_star","r_daily_task","r_ancient_book"]},{"id":"d_19","from":40,"to":40,"text":"苏天晴惊讶每日任务与守护之星竟然是真的。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_daily_task","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_20","from":41,"to":41,"text":"狐狐愣了一下，回头看向发微光的金色十字星，把它重新拿在手里。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox_body","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_21","from":42,"to":42,"text":"苏天晴判断金色十字星材质不明、做工精致、手感扎实、不像塑料玩具，应该是魔法少女必备的变身道具。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_22","from":43,"to":45,"text":"苏天晴思考每日任务要怎么查看，是否像前世网络小说一样默念系统，或者有特别解锁密码。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_daily_task"]},{"id":"d_23","from":46,"to":46,"text":"相较于莫名其妙的秘典，苏天晴对守护之星更感兴趣，眼中放出光彩。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_guardian_star","r_ancient_book"]},{"id":"d_24","from":47,"to":47,"text":"苏天晴想到魔法少女变身、穿华丽洋装在城市间穿梭飞行与怪人战斗，这具身体的原主人也曾经梦想过这种场面。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_su_original","r_villain_role"]},{"id":"d_25","from":48,"to":48,"text":"苏天晴自问要不要试试看。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_26","from":50,"to":50,"text":"狐狐试探性喊出变身。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_27","from":52,"to":52,"text":"苏天晴疑问变身不是这么喊，或要加前缀。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su_current","about":[]},{"id":"d_28","from":53,"to":56,"text":"狐狐先后喊出魔法少女变身、henshin、光啊、盖亚。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":[]},{"id":"d_29","from":57,"to":57,"text":"狐狐嗓子快喊哑，把能想到的变身词全喊了一遍，十字星仍无动静。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox_body","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_30","from":58,"to":58,"text":"苏天晴抱怨秘典不给新手指引，别人拿到系统有新手任务，至少该教怎么变身。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_ancient_book","r_daily_task"]},{"id":"d_31","from":59,"to":59,"text":"苏天晴觉得破玩意没意思。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_32","from":60,"to":63,"text":"狐狐气鼓鼓地瘫在沙发上，随手将十字星拿到面前端详，没见上面有写字，心中设想敲一下或搓动某个位置等办法；随后苏天晴盯着十字星中央能容纳一只手指的凹陷看了半晌，试探着将拇指摁了进去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox_body","r_su_current","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_33","from":64,"to":65,"text":"光芒笼罩客厅，一瞬白光消失，身体各处传来轻盈触感，脑海响起莫名声音。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su_current","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_34","from":66,"to":66,"text":"系统宣告初次变身已完成。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_system_voice","about":["r_su_current"]},{"id":"d_35","from":67,"to":67,"text":"苏天晴茫然惊叫什么东西。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su_current","about":[]},{"id":"d_36","from":68,"to":68,"text":"苏天晴意识到原来是触摸屏，还以为是声控。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_37","from":69,"to":73,"text":"苏天晴感受变身力量，走到卧室落地镜前，看到过膝白袜、金色短款洋装、缎带、胸前金色十字星、大尾巴与兽耳的华丽模样。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su_current","r_fox_body","r_guardian_star"]},{"id":"d_38","from":74,"to":75,"text":"看到变身后的模样，苏天晴对反派魔法少女身份的残存不满和抵触荡然无存，决心当这个反派魔法少女。","channel":"thought","mode":"promise","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_villain_role"]},{"id":"d_39","from":76,"to":76,"text":"镜中的狐狐眼神坚定，在胸前握紧拳头。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox_body"]},{"id":"d_40","from":77,"to":77,"text":"苏天晴想接下来该看看每日任务是怎么回事。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_daily_task"]},{"id":"d_41","from":78,"to":79,"text":"苏天晴维持变身后状态走回客厅，拿起不会说话的黑色古书小心翻开，第一页浮现几行文字。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su_current","r_ancient_book"]},{"id":"d_42","from":80,"to":81,"text":"书页显示身份：苏天晴，魔法少女（反派）。","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_ancient_book","about":["r_su_current","r_villain_role"]},{"id":"d_43","from":82,"to":84,"text":"书页发布每日任务1：找茬魔法少女；正牌魔法少女在蓉城风生水起已经够久了，给她一点颜色瞧瞧；奖励100神典石。","channel":"document","mode":"request","holder":"r_ancient_book","about":["r_daily_task","r_official_magical_girl","r_rongcheng","r_divine_stone"]},{"id":"d_44","from":85,"to":85,"text":"苏天晴疑问：找茬正牌魔法少女？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_official_magical_girl","r_daily_task"]},{"id":"d_45","from":86,"to":87,"text":"苏天晴微微一怔，觉得这看似简单的日常任务好像还真不好做。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su_current","about":["r_daily_task"]}],"beats":[{"id":"b_01","from":1,"to":3,"gist":"章节标题、作者关于角色均满18岁的声明与分隔线。","mode":"paratext","about":[]},{"id":"b_02","from":4,"to":16,"gist":"苏天晴洗漱后照镜自赏狐狐身体，舔镜并沉溺于可爱。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su_
